value.rationale: Holding the single-label reset hazard fixed gives invariant one-particle laws and a fair experimental protocol for isolating synchronization. An exact strictly ordered family of all positive radial tail risks at every time, coupled with strict conditional cross-label prediction and a signed-observable non-order boundary, supplies more experimentally meaningful information than a single covariance or far-tail rate; narrow assumptions and limits are clear.
